skill.summary: AI-powered agent that daily aggregates, summarizes, and analyzes crypto news to deliver sentiment, top coins, and market insights for traders and creators.

latestVersion.changelog:
Turn raw crypto news into actionable alpha.

This AI skill fetches the latest cryptocurrency news, analyzes market sentiment, identifies trending coins, and generates concise daily reports ready for publishing or decision-making.

Perfect for traders, content creators, and Web3 automation systems seeking an edge in the fast-moving crypto market.
